component.name: Metamorphosis
component.summary: Convert and edit files from a ring under your cursor
Convertir et retoucher des fichiers depuis un anneau sous le curseur

description.p: Drag a file, tap a key, and drop it on the holographic ring that opens under your cursor. Metamorphosis converts images, PDFs, video, audio, documents and archives, and offers tools such as crop, compress, redact, remove background and merge.
Everything runs offline. The original file is never modified: results are saved next to it.
On Wayland, a drop dock at the screen edge opens the ring when files are dragged onto it.
